input: Ceng ucwale piny, man ucwalu lero ma mor i yo mi adhura ma dhanu bedo i iye. Dhanu giwotho pio pio i dhu ngundu, tyend gi uwinjiri iwi ngudu, ma wec migi udore ni koko. I ot amata, nguce pa kawa ma juyubu nyen urombo ku nguce pa cam ma jutedo, ma ulwongo ju ma kadho ni cungo man ni camu. Juwer mi ngudu gi medo wer man rwom, ma giloko adhura ni kabedo ma leng man rangi. Kinde ma uthieno uthum, mac mi adthura ucaku lyel, man ucwalu myel pa kwo mi adthura ma rwinyo ngo.

I kind ngom malac pa godi man lum ma dongo, yamu uweco lembe ma pire tek ikind lum. Lei mi lum gi ringo piny i the lum, wotho migi calu ballet ma ling ma jutimo i the wang polo. Pii moko ubedo ka mol moth moth ikind ngom, wiye ubedo ka nyuthu lero pa ceng man ebedo ku rangi ma nya wang ma nyangu dhanu. Winy wer wer ma nen calu tito lembe mi ng'om, wer mi kwo ma winjere i ling. I kabedo ma ling eni, sawa nen ni ube rwinyo, ma weko kare mi paru man kuc udongo.

I ot kwan madit, kama jugwoku i iye buku upong ku buku mi lembe matung tung. Ngwic pa karatasi ma oti man jam tedo ma juyubu ku del upong iwi yamu, ma ulwongo ju ma giyenyo ngec ni cidho i ng'om mapol. Jusom gibedo i kabedo maber man i meza ma lac, wang gi ube neno karatasi ma wigi ubewotho i iye, lembe, man piny ma ginwangu. Pol kare, dwand mi loko karatasi uketho dwand ma ling pa bedo moth. Woku, ng'om umediri ku ngwec pare, ento i kind cel eni, ng'om mi ryeko man paru ukwo i ling ling.

I soko ma dhanu upong i iye, jurulwor gikok matek pi wil migi, ma gibe temo ni nwangu nen pa dhanu i kind dwand ma dwong. Ka cato wil upong ku nying yen ma leng, jamb tedu ma ngic, man bongo ma rangi migi tung tung, piny acel acel weco ikum acaki man tic. Juruwil gibed giweco iwi bei piny man giloko lembe, ma uketho gibedo ku winjiri maber. Ngwic pa ringu ma juwango man mugati ma mit ubedo ka nyai i yamu, ma ucwalu ju ma kadho i yo ni camu. Ikind lembe ma rac, ubedu ku rwom moko ma ubedu piny — rwom ma ubedu ka ketho soko ubedo kwo man ma tek, lanyuth pa cwiny mi bedo karacelu.

I wi nam malac, pii ucwale iwi yei, man ucwalu pii ma kadho i polo. Jurutic ne giwotho ku lembakeca, giloko yei man giwotho i dye nam macol, ma gitelo wigi ku lakalatwe kende man ngec ma gisomo. Ngom ucungo ma rwinyo, rangi ma loko loko nicaku i uthieno nituc i diewor, ma nyutho leng pa ng'om ma rwinyo. Seagulls ucungo iwi wigi, dwandgi uwinjiri iwi pii, ma umedire dwand nam. Kadi bende nam ubedo kende, paru mi wotho man mi nwangu piny manyen ubedu maber ikind piny ma jik ungo.

I kind pacu mi adhura ma dhanu bedo i iye, ngyeru pa awiya uwinjiri kani gibetuko iwi swings man slides. Juru ot gibedo ka cam iwi jam umo ma juketho iwi lum, gipoko lembe man gibedo kud anyonga ikindgi i the tipo pa yen madongo. Ju ma ringo man ju ma ringo gari giwotho iwi yo ma nyai, wotho migi uketho bedo maber pa ngom i kind kwo mi adhura. Ducks ku swans giwotho maber iwi pii, ma umedire ku kuc. Kinde ma ceng ubekadhu, kabedo mi yom cwiny ulokore ni kabedo ma ling ma dhanu mi adhura ginwangu iye yom kud i tic migi ma nja.

Wi got ne umiyu neno maber pa godi man godi mabor. Ju ma giwotho iwi got gicokiri i dhu mac ma nok, gipoko lembe ikum wotho migi man lek migi mi anyim. Yamo ubedo maleng man ma nyayu tego, ma upongo ombo ku yamu maleng man ma nyayu tego. Kabedo pa pee ucungo iwi got, ma ryeny i the lero pa ceng, ma ukoc ku ngom macol man lum ma nok piny. Kinde ma pol ubekadhu, tipo ubekadhu iwi ngom, ma nyutho leng pa ngom. Ka icungu iwi ngom, ngati moko winjo bedo ku winjiri madit ku ber pa ngom.

I pacu ma ling, juru ot gibedu ka timo tic migi ku dwand maber. Awia gibedu ka tugu hopscotch iwi ngudu, ngyeru migi ubedu ka winjere iwi yamu, ma junyodo ubedu ka nenu kud i dhugola. Podho upong ku rangi matung tung — roses, tulips, daisies — zo gibe pyem pi lero pa ceng man nen pa dhanu. Ngwic pa lum ma nyen man thiwe ma dongo uketho kabedo maber ma uketho ot ubedo maleng. Odhiambo ukelo ler ma nyap pa mac mi ngudu man bedo ku kuc ma dhanu mapol gineno ngo ento ju maru akeca.

Kabedo macon ma ukadhu ubedo lembe pa kwo macon, cel migi ma jugiero ku kidi ma rwinyo man ma rii. Vines ku moss ubedo ka mol i dhu lum, ma nyutho kite ma kare ukadhu kudu man kite ma piny ube dwoko ko piny ma dhanu ucwio. Ju ma giwotho i ng'om giwotho ikind dhugola man dyekal, giparu kwo ma con ubedo i ot eni. Ling ne ubedo malac, ju turo kende ku dwand tyend dhanu man lwongu pa winy mabor. Kinde ma ceng upodho in ngeye kidi, tipo umedire, ma ukelo lworo man woro iwi kabedo ne. Ubedo ponji pa bedo pa lembe mukadho man lembe ma jugoro i kidi acel acel.

I terminal mi bar ndege ma dhanu bedo lee i iye, juwotho ukadhu pio pio ku paru man mitu. Taya pa jeni ugam ucungo iwi dier ot ma juyubu maber, ma wec i dhok matung tung upong iwi yamu. Digital screens unyutho sawa mi wok man tuc, ma ucwalu juwotho ma cwinygi lith ungo nyo ma cwinygi yom ni tuc kama gicidho i iye. Kopo mi kawa man jam umu cam ma yot upong i dhu kor ot moko, lanyuth pa cam miwikugweno ma jutimo pio pio man yiko piny i dakika ma tok cen. Ikind lembe ma nya wang ma juyubu, lembe moko ubedu nuti — kare ma nok mi bedo karacelu ikind ju ma jungeyo ngo ma ubedu ku miti marom mi lubo tok lembe, dwogo, nyo yenyo acaki manyen. Wotho ne ubedo ka mediri kende.

I cula ma leng, pii ma mol ucungo iwi dhu nam ma leng, ma lwongo dhanu ni bedo moth man paru. Yath pa palm ubedo ka yeng iwi yamu nam, cal migi ubedo tung tung ku polo ma leng. Ju ma giwotho i dhu nam gibedo ka lwoko ceng, gigero udi madongo, man gicoko lum mi nam, gitimo lembe ma yot ma nyutho paradiso. Ithere pii, got ma leng ma leng ma upong ku kwo mi nam ma rangi migi tung tung, ma nen kud i pii maleng ma nyutho ngom ma ungwe. Kinde ma uthieno udhingo, polo udoko makwar ku rangi ma orange man pink, ma nyutho thum pa ceng mange i kabedo ma ling eni. Leng pa cula ne umiyu kabedo maleng mabor ku koko pa kwo ma kubang ceng.

I ot mi tic ma kawoni, jurutic gitimo tic karacelu i ot mi coko ma juketho ku gilasi man kabedo mi tic ma oyabere. Dwol pa kompyuta man dwand pa simu uketho dwand ma rwinyo, ma ucungo iwi dii pa keyboard man loko karatasi. Kabedo mi yom cwiny umiyu kare mi yom, ku jurutic wadwa madhu kawa man wec ma yot. Whiteboards man screens nyuthu charts, timelines mi tic, man paru ma ubetimere, zo timo tic ikum paru acel. Kadi bende tic ubedu katimere de, ubedu ku nen pa lembe manyen man lembe manyen ma ubedu ka nyuthu yeny mi dongo man lonyo.

Kabedo mi gari ma dhanu bedo i iye ubedo kabedo mi wotho, kama lembe madwong urombo i iye. Juwotho gi ringo pio pio ni maku gari migi, maku cing gi man cing gi, acel acel ku kama gicidho i iye man lek migi. Juruwil ucwalu cam ma yot man gazeti inget kabedo mi tiket ma dwand dhanu winjo man lwongo. Kabedo ne ungwel ku genogen ma injin ubedo ka koko, ma nyutho nia jubewok man jubetuc. I kabedu ma nyai eni, kare mi bedo karacelu man mi weko dhanu urombo, ma dwoko rwom pa kwo ma kubang ceng i ng'om ma rwinyo ngo.

I kind lum, lero pa ceng wok kud i kind lum, man eketho rangi macol iwi ngom mayom piny. Lei ma tung tung giwotho ling ling i kabedu migi, acel acel timo tic pare i kind kwo. Yamu ubedo ku nguce pa moss, pine, man ngom ma pii, ma ukelo nen pa kwo macon. Pii ma mol moth ucungo ikind yen, dwand pare ubedo calu wer maber pa lum ma ling. Kabedo maleng eni ma dhanu ungiyo ngo ubedo lanyuth pa tego pa piny man ber pa kabedu ma dhanu ungiyo ngo.

Ot tedo ma dhanu bedo i iye upong ku tic ma juru tedo gibe tedo cam matung tung. Dwol ma lyethu kud i skillets ma rwinyo ku nguce pa lum, jamb tedu, man mugati ma jutedo nyen, ma weko kabedo maber. Jam tedo jupoko, juyubu, man juyike maber, acel acel uketho wil bedo maber. Jurutic giwotho maber ikind kabedo, gi timo lembe karacelu mi neno nia sahan acel acel utuc maber. Welo gibedo kakuru cam migi, man gen migi umedire ka wil ma juyubu bino karacelu — cam acel acel ubedo tic mi cing ma juyike pi nyayo anyonga man cwiny.

I ot mi nyuthu cal, cel juyike ku cal matung tung, cal ma juyubu, man cal. Juruwil giwotho moth moth kud i dul acel acel ni dul mange, ngati acel acel ucungu pi ni gonyo man ni nyang ikum paru pa juwer. Mac ne unyutho rangi man lembe matung tung, ma ukelo kwo pa cal ne. Wec ma ling ikum diru, paru, man the lembe umedu rwom pa ngec. Kabedo ne ubedo kabedo maleng pi ryeko man paru, kama tego pa nen piny uketho dhanu gineno piny manyen man uketho dhanu paru paru.

I diewor ma piny ucaku i pii, lum ucungu moth moth kud iwi pii, man eketho piny ubedo maleng. Ducks giwotho ku yei ma rwinyo, giweko pii i ngeye, ma dragonflies gi ringo iwi lum. Ling pa ceng utur kende kende ku dwand winyo ma wer ma jolo ceng. Yen ma ucungu eca nenre i pii ma oling, ma medo bedo moth. Saa ma ling eni unyutho leng pa piny ma ling ma podi ngom unyai ungo, ma poyo wic mwa ikum kuc ma nwangre i kwo pa piny.

Mac mi ot tuko ne udoko nyathotho ka curtain ucungo, man unyutho kabedo ma juyike pi tuko ma dhanu copo wil ungo. Jutugo gimondo i tic migi, ginyutho dhanu ku miti man yioyic, ma gikelo lembe ni kwo. Juwinj gibedo kud anyonga, ngyeru man goyo cing ucungo ikum lembe ma nyayu can man aloka loka madit. Wer man mac umedire ku paru man kite ma piny nen kudu, ma uloko kabedo ne ni kabedo mi paru man mi wur. Kinde ma tuko ne uthum, dhanu ucaku goyo cing gi, pi foc pi diro man kero migi ma uketho tuko ne ubedo lembe ma dhanu ceke copo poyo wigi ngo.

I adhura ma ling, ot ucungu i rwom maber, ot acel acel ku podho pare ma upong ku thiwe man lum macol. Yore ne upong ku wang dhanu ma jung'eyo man ju ma timo lembe maber, ma nyutho bedo karacelu man bedo maber. Awia gibedu ka tugu i podho, ma judongo gibedu ka timo tic mi ot nyoke gibedu kaweco iwi baraza. Dwol ma yot pa kwo ma kubang ceng ucwio kabedo maber, ma nyutho beru pa pacu man bedo karacelu. Kinde ma uthieno upodhu, ler ma nyap pa mac mi baraza ugam ujolo dyewor, man uketho kwo mi adhura bedo ku kuc.

Yo mi got ne ucungo malo kud i ngom ma nyap, ma nyayu peko i kum ju ma wotho iwi got ku got mabor man got. Thenge acel acel umito kero man miti, ma judwoko ire ku neno piny mabecu i wi got. Yamo ma ngic mi got uketho dhanu bedo ku tego, man thiwe man yen ma tek ucungo iwi got. Pol kare, koko mabor pa ungwal nyo neno diel mi got poyo wi ju ma giwotho i ng'om mange pi leng pa lum ma ucungu gi. Tuc i wi got ubedo kare maber, lanyuth pa bedo moth man tego pa piny ma nyayu lworo.

Ka cato wil i adhura macon ubedo kabedo ma dhanu timo iye lembe madwong, ku juruwil ma gibe koko pi wil migi man juruwil gibe wilu piny migi kud anyonga. Ka cato wil upong ku piny ma juyubu ku cing, jamb tedu, man bongo, piny acel acel nyuthu piny moko ma pire tek mi tekwaro pa adhura. Ngwic pa cam ma tung tung upong i yamu, ma ucwalu ju ma kadho i yo ni temo wil manyen. Dwol pa wer man myel pa juwer ma ceng kudu umedire ku kwo maber. Kabedo ma dhanu bedo i iye ubedo makadhu kabedo mi timo kuloka kende; ubedu kabedo ma lembe mukadho, kura migi, man bedo karacelu pa dhanu.

I the polo mi diewor, mac ma lyel ucwalu tipo ma nyai iwi wang juwotho ma ool. Ka gipoko lembe man giwero wer, gibedo kud anyonga ma yot mi bedo jurimo. Mac ma lyel ubemio lyethu ikum yamu ma ngic, ma lakala malu ubemio ler mi polo ma ber mandha. Lwongo mabor pa owl man dwand lum ma nyap uketho kabedo maber. I saa maeni, ikind piny man jurimo, sawa nen calu ucungo kende, ma nyutho berocwiny ma rwinyo pa wotho woko.

Cokone mi somo ukelo jurusomo kud i ng'om zoo karacelu pi poko paru man wecu ikum lembe manyen. Ju ma weco iwi lembe madongo gi miyo ponji ma nyayu anyonga, ma ukelo yore manyen mi penji man tic karacelu. Breakout sessions uketho dhanu bedo ku wec maber, ma uketho dhanu ma paru migi nyang ikum lembe. Poko ngec ubedo ku rwom ma malu ku yub mi rombo ku dhanu man tic mi tekwaro, ma umedire ku ngec ma kadhu somo. Kinde ma coko ne uthum, ju m'ubedo i coko ne utingo paru manyen man wadi, ma ukelo dongo i tic migi.

Koth ma nyap upoto iwi adhura, man uketho dwand moko ucungo iwi dirisa man wi ot. Ju ma wotho ku tyendgi giwotho pio pio i the umbrella, wotho migi pio pio ento giwotho pio pio ungo, calu ma ler ubedo ka rieny iwi ngudu ma pii. Ngwic pa ngom ma pii man koth ma leng uketho dhanu bedo ku tego, man emiyo dhanu bedo manyen ikind kwo mi adhura. Mac mi ngudu ucwalu ler macol, ma ukoc ku polo macol, ma medu lyethu i kabedo ne. Bedo moth man kwiocwiny ugam uloko kabedo pa lworo macon, ma adhura ujolo koth, ma poyo wi dhanu ceke ikum tego pa ngom.

Ot pa Mungu macon ucungu calu lanyuth pa tic pa dhanu man kura pa tipo, cel pare ma jugiero ku kidi ubedo ku yamo man koth ma rac pi oro madwong. Cal ma jugoro maber man cal ma juyubu iwi kore, ma ubeweco iwi lembe mi woro man lembe mi rundi ma con. Ju ma giwotho i pacu man ju ma gibino i ng'om zoo ginwangu kony man tego cwiny i kabedu pare ma ling, kama ling man woro upong i yamu. Bedo pa hekalu uketho kare mukadho ku kare ma kawoni, ubedo calu lanyuth maleng pa lembe macon man yenyo the lembe. Calu lero pa ceng wok kud i kind vur man vur, nen pa piny ma nja uketho kabedo ne.

Carnival ma kwo ubedo ku rangi, dwal, man anyonga. Rides spun man soared, upong ku koko pa anyonga, ma game stalls umiyu kare mi nwangu mic man ngyeru. Juwer ma gi ruko kendi gi nyayo anyonga ni dhanu ku tuko mi ngwec, timo mi jok, man wer, ma mako paru pa dhanu mi oro zo. Ngwic pa cotton candy, popcorn, man grilled sausages uketho ju ma gibino i coko ne gi maru. Kinde ma diewor upodho, mac ma rieny man wer uketho dhanu bedo ku tego ma lee dit ma nyayu anyonga, bedo karacelu, man bero ma yot mi kwo.

I thenge mi ot buku ma ling, kom acel kende ma ler ucwale ku tara, ma lwongo jakwan ni bedo i buku. Pot karatasi ne ubedo ku ng'om mi ngwec, ngec, man paru, acel acel ubedo dhugola mi nyang manyen nyo ringo. Ling pa piny uketho dhanu bedo ku paru man paru, kabedo ma leng kud i lembe ma rac ma woko. Kago, kabedo ma juyubu ku wi lembe man jagor umiyu lembe madwong pa paru pa dhanu man diru migi. Kabedo mi mitu mi ngeyo lembe eni unyutho tego pa kwan mi ketho cwiny, ponji, man loko dhanu.

Podho mi mzabibu ne ucungo iwi godi ma dongo dongo, mzabibu pare upong ku mzabibu ma dongo ma juyiko pi kawo. Jurutic gibed giwotho ikind rwom, gipoko man gikwanyo, ngati acel acel ubedu ka gwoko ngom ku diro man ngec. Ceng ucwalu rangi macol iwi ngom ma leng, ma ukelo rangi macol man macol macol. Yamu upong ku nguce ma mit pa nying yen man ngom, ma nyutho kwo mi fur. Kinde ma kare mi keyo udhingo, gen umedire pi kongo ma podi juyubu kud i lum ma pigi tek eni.

Adhura ma upong ku pee ubedo kabedo maber mi neno i kare mi ngico, ku wi ot ma umu ku rangi matar man icicles ma ucungo iwi wi ot. Yore ubedo ling, ma oling pi podho pa pee, ma ukelo ling ma ling. Awia gicaku snowman man gibedo ku lwiny mi snowball, ngyeru migi uwinjiri kud i yamu ma leng. Mac ma mor kud i ot ma nok man duka nen maleng ku kabedo ma ngic, ma ukelo anyonga. Kabedo eca zo nen calu ube rieny ku leng pa kare ne, ma ulwongo dhanu ceke ni jolo kwiocwiny pa kare mi ngico.

I adhura ma dit ma dhanu bedo i iye, yei ma tingo piny man yei ma mako rec ubedu ka mol i dhu nam, man yei migi ucwale malo. Jurutic mi yei giwotho pio pio, gi ketho man giwodho piny ma ukelo dongo pa adhura man uketho edoko ku ng'om zoo. Kabedo mi soko i dhu nam umiyu rec ma nyen, piny ma juyubu ku cing, man piny mi poyo wic ni juwotho man ju mi ​​kabedu ne. Ngwic pa pii ma kadu, rec, man diesel ma ucungo iwi yamu, nyutho kwo pa kwo mi nam. Kinde ma yei ucaku wotho nyo utuc, adhura ne ubedo maber pi wotho, kuloka, man ywak pa nam.

Ngec mi tedo mugati upong ot mi tedo mugati ku nguce ma mor man ma lwongo dhanu ma kadho i iye. Mugati man mugati ma jutedo nyen juyike maber akeca i kabedo mi nyuthu piny, adila migi macol man jamb tedu migi ma leng ma nyayu anyonga. Juyiku mugati gibed giwero wer kinde ma gibe tedo mugati man gi tedo mugati, diru migi nen kamaleng i lembe ceke. Juruwil gibedo kud anyonga ikum kabedo maber, madhu cam maber ku kawa nyo chai, gibeweco iwi cam ma jutedo. Tic mi tedo eni unyayu cam kende ento uketho dhanu bedo karacelu nikadhu kud i kura migi, ryeko, man anyonga ma yot pa cam maber.

I kind tic ma dhanu zo timo, jurudiro gitimo tic matek ikum tic migi, acel acel nyuthu diru man mar pa tic. Jam tic eca ucaku ikum yen man cuma nitundu ikum bongo man ngom, ku jurudiro ma giloko piny ma podi juyubu ungo ni tic mi cing. Dwol pa saws, hammers, man looms urombo i symphony mi cwic. Ju ma bino bino maru tic mi cing, pol kare gibedo ku miti mi timo tic migi mi cing. Ka ponji ne ubedo lanyuth pa ryeko pa dhanu man bero pa piny ma juyubu ku cing man ma pire tek.

I kind foc ma dit, yei ma juyubu ku thiwe man mac ubedu kawothu i ngudu, pi kwero lemb dhanu man cwiny pa dhanu. Juwer ma gi ruko bongo gi myel man gi goyo wer, ma uketho dhanu ma oro migi tung tung gibedo kud anyonga. Kabedo mi cam umiyu cam ma mit pa suru, ma poko wil pa dhanu macon. Yamu upong ku anyonga, ngyeru, man anyonga ma dhanu ceke bedo kudu pi timo tic. Kinde ma diewor upodho, mac ucwale iwi polo, ma nyutho thum pa lembe ma ber man ma jupoi ma ukelo dhanu karacelu pi kwir.

Kabedo ma ling ubedo kabedo pa podho man lum, kama sawa nen ni ube rwinyo. Jurufur gibed gi gwoko kodhi man lei, kura migi ugam ucungo iwi lembe macon. Caru ma nok ma juketho i kind lum, ku udi ma nok ma nen maleng. Dwol ma mwol pa ngom — winy ma wer, yamu ma mol kud i lum, koko pa dhyeng mabor — uketho wer maber. Kabedo maber eni umiyu kabedo mi yweyo kud i kwo mi adhura, ma poyo wi welo ikum kuc man bedo yot ma nwangre i kwo pa piny.

I ot yath ma kawoni, jurutic mi yot kum gitimo tic matek pi gwoko jurutwo, man miti migi nenre i timo migi ceke. Kabedo ma leng ubedo kabedo madit mi tic, ku jurutwo man daktari ma gibetimo tic mi yath man gibe lubo lanyuth ma pire tek. Teknoloji ma malu okonyo ni nwangu two man ni dwoko piny, ma nyutho rwom pa kisa man timo piny manyen. Jurutwo ginwangu tego cwiny i ngec man berocwiny pa jurutic, ma gigeno yub migi mi dwoko yot kum man bedo maber. Kabedo eni ubedo lanyuth pa tego cwiny pa dhanu man yenyo mi cango.

Kabedo ma thwol ubedo malac ma jik ungo, kabedo malac pa lum man got macol i the ceng ma lyeth. Cacti ku lum ma tek gikwo i kabedu ma rac eni, tek cwiny migi uketho dhanu bedo ku lworo. Juwotho giwotho i ng'om ku bedo moth, gingeyo peko man leng pa ngom eni. Mirages ubedo ka rieny mabor, lembe ma nyayu lworo ma nyayu lworo i wang dhanu ento umedire leng pa ngom. Ceng ma podho uloko lum ni rangi makwar man orange, nen pa tego pa piny man leng pa piny.

Ot maber ma juketho ikind yen madongo umiyu kabedo ma leng kud i ng'om ma woko. Kabedo mi mac uwang, man ucwalu ler ma mor ma umedire ku deko. Welo gibedo ku buku nyo poko lembe, ma gibedo kud anyonga pa kabedo migi. Woku, pee upodho moth, ma umo ngom ku rangi matar, ento iiye, lyethu man bedo maber ubedo. Kabedo ma ceng eni uketho i iye bedo yot man kweyo cwiny ma nwangre i rwom pa piny, kabedo maber mi yom cwiny man dwoko kwo manyen.

I ot tuko mi adhura ma leng, jurutugo gi yube in ngeye, lworo man anyonga migi nen kamaleng. Juruwer gi goyo wer migi maber, ma dhanu ube goyo cing gi man wec upong i ot madit. Kinde ma dhugola ucungo, ka tuku ne ulokore ni ng'om mi tuko, ngyeru, nyo can, ma mako dhanu man ma nyayu paru migi. Dikiri pa tuko — juru tugu, juwer, jurutic mi kabedo — ucwio tic maber ma rwinyo ma ubedu nuti kende i saa maeca. Kinde ma tuko mir ajiki uthum man dhanu ucaku goyo cing gi, tic mi theatre upoyo wi dhanu ceke ikum tego pa tito lembe man nyuthu paru pa dhanu.

Kabedo mi monastery ma kuc ubedo kabedo mi paru man kwiocwiny. Jukony giwotho ling ling ikind ot pa kanisa, gwoko podho man yiko pi rwo ma kubang ceng. Ngwic pa ubani man thiwe ma nyai umedu anyonga pa tipo, ma ukelo bedo moth man ling. Ju ma bino nyo ju ma bedo keca ginwangu kony i kwo mayot man ku cik mi kwo mi kanisa, kama paru man bedo karacelu ubedu karacelu. I kabedo mi gedo ma dhanu bedo lee i iye, jurutic gicokiri pi gier ot manyen, acel acel umiyu ngec pare. Got ma leng ma julwongo ni coral reef upong ku kwo i the pii maleng mi nam. I ot pa Mungu pa Buddhist ma ling, jukwenda gitimo lembe mi dini man paru, ma gikelo kabedo ma ling man ma timo lembe mi tipo. Ngwic pa ubani ubedo ka mol i yamu ma wer ubedo ka winjere moth, ma ucwalu ju ma timo tic ne i ot. Cal man cal pa mungu ubedo kabedo mi rwo man paru, ma uketho dhanu bedo ku winjiri man woro. Welo ma gibe sayu kuc man ryeko ginwangu tego cwiny i ot pa Mungu ma rwinyo. Kabedo maleng ma kumeno ubedo kabedo mi ngiyo lembe man mi dongo kisa.

Kabedo mi ski ma leng ubedo ku tic ma lee dit, calu ju ma giwotho iwi ski man ju ma giwotho iwi snowboard giwotho iwi got ma pong ku pee. Kombe ma tingo welo utingo welo ikum got, ma umiyu nen maber pa ngom ma umu ku pee. I ngei nindu acel mi wotho, welo gicokiri i ot maber, gipoko lembe man gi lyel ku mac ma lyel. Ngwic pa chocolate ma lyet man cam ma leng upong yamu, ma ukelo anyonga. Kabedo mi tugu mi kare mi ngico eni ubedo foc mi adrenaline, ngom, man bedo jurimo, ma uketho poyo wic ma rii pi kare malac ingey pee uthum.

I kind laboratory ma ber, ju ma gisomo lembe mi ng'om gitimo lembe ma jutimo ku rieko, ma gicungo iwi lembe ma jutimo man ngec migi. Dukan buku maber ma ni i Main Street ukwayu ju ma gimaru buku ku wange maber man kabedo pare ma upong ku buku. Jusom gineno buku ma jucoko maber, man ginwangu jugor manyen man buku macon ma rwinyo. Kabedo eni mi giragora uketho bedo karacelu, paru, man ponji, uketho bedo karacelu ikind wec ku ju ma gimaru gi.

I podho madit mi lum, lum ma dongo dongo ma aa kud i ng'om zoo jubedu ka nyuthu gi i kabedo ma juyike maber. Podho ne ubedo kabedo maleng ni ju ma gingeyo lembe man ju ma nyen, calu piny ma kwo ma nyuthu leng pa piny man ryeko pa dhanu.

Kabedo mi tugu ma leng ubedo ku anyonga man lworo ku roller coasters, Ferris wheels, man tugu. I ot welo ma ling, welo gibedo ku kwiocwiny kud i tic mi kwo ma kubang ceng. Jam ot ma leng man mac ma mor uketho kabedo bedo maber, man cam maber uketho bedo maber man kwo. Kite ma won ot pa welo ubedo kudu uketho dhanu bedo ku paru mi bedo i pacu man bedo moth, ma uketho welo giwinjo maber. Kabedo eni ma yot man ma leng umiyu kare mi yom cwiny, ma udwoko juwotho ku kwo ma yot man ma rwinyo pa kwo mi caru.

Ot mi gwoko piny macon ma leng man ma kawoni unyutho piny matung tung mi cal, lembe mukadho, man lembe mi ngec. Kit ma juyubu kudu ot eca ubedo tic mi cing, ma uketho i iye kit ma juyubu kudu piny manyen ni medo piny ma ju nyuthu i iye. Yub mi somo man lembe ma pire tek uketho dhanu bedo ku miti mi ngeyo lembe man ponji. Ot mi gwoko piny macon ubedo calu dhugola ma rwate ku lembe mukadho, kawoni, man anyim, ma ucwalu welo ni nyang ikum ryeko pa dhanu man ryeko migi i lembe matung tung.

I wi got ma ling, ot lega moko ma nok nen piny ma ucungu, man ot pare ucungo malo. Juwotho man welo bino pi nwangu kony, rwo, nyo neno piny ma leng. Cel ma jugiero ku kidi man ot ma iye yot unyutho mwolo man woro, ma ukelo kare mi paru man bedo karacelu. Kabedo ne ubedo lanyuth pa kero pa dhanu mi dongo man nyang ikum lembe mi tipo. I kare ma ceng podho, ot lega nen calu ler mi gen man kuc ikind piny ma dongo dongo.
